title_zh: 重播动画片引发的爷青回
title_en: New Slang, New Stories (8/20): A Cartoon Rerun Brings Back "My Youth"
note_en: 一……就…… means "as soon as ...", but in this text it appears in a shortened form, with only 一: 熟悉的开场音乐一响起，他整个人瞬间愣住 "the moment the familiar theme music started, he froze." Put 一 right before the first verb (here 响起), and the second clause shows what happens immediately afterward; English needs "the moment" or "as soon as" at the start.
